page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a large display title block at the top (LIBER / PRIMUS / PHYSICORVM, then an italic subtitle) above the running text. No margin notes. Page number printed top left. A small signature-like mark at the foot is not transcribed.

main_text.l: à vulgi oculis ea remouerent, quemad-
notum est. Hunc ritum secutus est Moy-
ses, cùm libros legum non cuiq; plebeio,
tæ omnes id obseruarunt, quoties locuti
non tam facilè capitur. Græci ergo
rumque Magis acceperunt, sic etiam eos
Hinc tot fuere primo aspectu absurdæ
sententiæ de rerum principijs. Nam, vt re-
fert Empir. l. 3. c. 4. Thales Milesius dixit,
ex atomis, Empedocles ex lite, amicitia,
alia, in quorum dictis latent fanè misteria,
& sésus occulti, quos quia Hipparcus Py-
la eiectus est, in eiusq; locum immobilis

page.notes: Page number "14" at top left, printed small and partly smudged. Some words near the end of the last line are blurred by a stain and the final line is partly obscured by a printed mark at the foot, which is not transcribed.
